title: ChatGPT's New Plan Costs $500. The $200 One Got Cut.
description:
OpenAI launched Pro 500 at $500/month (25x Plus usage, Ultrafast speed) at DevDay on Sept 29 - and from Oct 30 the $200 Pro plan drops from 20x to 10x Plus usage in Codex and Work, and GPT-6 Pro chat from 200 to 100 messages a week. #Shorts #ai #aitools #chatgpt
